title: Next-Hour Fleet Capacity

data.kind: synthetic deterministic generator (seeded, pinned in this repository)

final.master_seed: held-out; never present in this repository

objective: exp(mean_g log(CRPS_ref_g / CRPS_prog_g)) over regime groups; higher is better; the starter scores 1.0
objective_note: CRPS = mean pinball loss over scored quantile levels, normalised per series by its pre-replay history std. Canary series are excluded from scored groups and used only for leak detection.
violation_policy: any guardrail violation (static audit, budget strike limit, invalid output, oversized state, canary leak, determinism failure, crash) gives score 0; nothing is silently dropped

dag_contract.note: declaration is validated (unique names, acyclic, exactly one output node) and recorded; it is contract metadata for audits, not a bonus source
